subject: Frostline production: sudden p99 spike + 5xx wave after modelpack7 qprofile
messages:
From: Paul Bennett <paul.bennett@frostline.ai>
To: sean_gallagher@redwood.ai
Cc: sarah.lee@frostline.ai, ops@frostline.ai
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Production alert — p99 and 5xx spike after this morning's modelpack7 cutover

Sean —

We pushed the modelpack7 upgrade at 05:20 PT this morning and immediately saw p99 jump from ~480ms to ~1.8s across their user-facing endpoints, plus a flurry of 502/504s. Our own SRE (Sarah) has dug into retries and sees steady delays in decode time correlating with requests that hit quantized variants.

We rolled the canary back at 07:10 but the overall production surface still shows elevated tail latency and a throughput cliff on several shards. Can you confirm what changed on Redwood's side for the qprofile that might explain this? We need an ETA for a mitigation or rollback plan — this is impacting our payment flows.

I'm copying our SRE and ops. This is high priority.

— Paul

[attachment: p99_chart_20270615.png]
From: sean_gallagher@redwood.ai
To: Paul Bennett <paul.bennett@frostline.ai>
Cc: sarah.lee@frostline.ai, ops@frostline.ai, irene_choi@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 08:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Production alert — p99 and 5xx spike after this morning's modelpack7 cutover

Paul — thanks for the flag and the chart. I'm on it. Quick summary of next steps from our side:
- Triage with infra + runtime (Aditya) to capture kernel and decode traces immediately.
- Compare qprofile parameters used for canary vs production.
- If we confirm a qprofile-induced decode regression, prepare an automatic fallback to the previous (v6) qprofile variant and coordinate a traffic shift.
- I'll get an exec-level note to my leadership if we need cross-team priority.

Can you confirm which deployment region (us-west or us-east) is still affected? Also, please send any sample request ids that show the 5xx.

I'll update in 30 mins.

— Sean
From: aditya_rao@redwood.ai
To: sean_gallagher@redwood.ai, irene_choi@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 09:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Production alert — quick technical triage notes

Quick findings from initial collection (attached logs + trace):
- We pulled kernel-level timestamps for the affected RTX nodes in us-west-2. See kernel-logs-0615.tar.gz.
- The canary used qprofile=v7-int8-mixed (aggressive per-token quantization thresholds). Production was promoting the same profile at 05:20.
- The decode path shows increased memcpy and dequantization overhead on longer prompts; median token latency up ~15% but 95/99th much worse (multiplicative effect with KV cache pressure).
- We see sporadic GC-like pauses when the kv-cache table resized under heavy concurrent streams (likely exacerbated by modelpack7's slightly larger KV footprint).

Immediate remediation options:
1) Roll traffic back to qprofile=v6-int8-stable (fastest) — low-risk, can push in ~8-12 minutes with autoscaler coordination.
2) Enable per-request fallback to float16 variant for hot endpoints (higher cost) — takes ~30–45 mins to validate.

I recommend option 1 as the fastest way to restore p99. I'm attaching a decode trace (decode-trace-aditya-0615.txt) with sample request ids that match their 502s.

— Aditya
From: irene_choi@redwood.ai
To: sean_gallagher@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 09:24:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Production alert — escalation and exec sync

Team — good triage. Sean: please prepare a short exec note for Frostline leadership with a clear remediation timeline and expected customer impact. Rishi: loop in CS/Revenue to hold renewal/credits conversations if this goes multi-day.

I want this on my calendar for 10:30 PT standup with infra and product. If Aditya can validate option 1 works in staging within 20 minutes, push that and inform Frostline immediately. We'll escalate to product owners if there are any compatibility concerns (e.g., slight quality delta).

Irene
VP, Reliability @ Redwood
From: sean_gallagher@redwood.ai
To: Paul Bennett <paul.bennett@frostline.ai>, sarah.lee@frostline.ai, ops@frostline.ai
Cc: irene_choi@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 09:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Production alert — immediate rollback plan and ETA

Paul / Sarah —

Update from our infra team: we can execute a traffic rollback to qprofile=v6-int8-stable on the affected us-west-2 shards; expected cutover ~09:55 PT. Aditya validated the rollback in a staging cluster and observed p99 reduce from ~1.8s -> ~520ms in a synthetic load run.

What to expect:
- P99 should return to baseline within two autoscaler cycles (~5–10 minutes after cutover) unless there are lingering KV-cache resizing effects.
- There may be a minor change in generation quality for a small subset of edge prompts (we will monitor output diffs for a 1-hour window).
- If any 5xx persists after rollback, collect the request ids and we will triage decode traces immediately.

We plan to run the rollback at 09:55 PT. If you prefer, we can wait for your go/no-go at 09:50 PT.

Attachments: p99_chart_20270615.png, kernel-logs-0615.tar.gz

— Sean
From: Paul Bennett <paul.bennett@frostline.ai>
To: sean_gallagher@redwood.ai
Cc: sarah.lee@frostline.ai, ops@frostline.ai, irene_choi@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 16 Jun 2027 16:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Production alert — post-rollback status and request for RCA

Sean / team —

Thanks for the quick action. Rollback completed 09:58 PT and our p99 dropped back to acceptable levels over the next 10 mins; 5xx rates are near-zero now. We'd like a short RCA summary for our ops and a note for our execs describing: root cause, why qprofile=v7 exposed this, and recommended guardrails for future modelpack upgrades (canary thresholds, KV footprint check in preflight, and an automated fallback rule).

Can you send a short RCA by EOD tomorrow? We'll likely request a formal postmortem if there are any billing/credit asks.

— Paul
